One mask pays 83 POA and waits 7 days; a farm pays 34777 POA and still waits 7 days per mask. The farm's velvet arrived yesterday, its anchor arrived this morning, and its canyon never arrived at all. The trail is short enough to follow by hand and long enough to catch a farm. Harvest comes for honest agents; the farm finds the field fenced before it arrives.
